crossRefs.note: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.
Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
I wrote for him the many things of my law; but they were regarded as a strange thing.
From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith, which is…
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…

translations.web: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
translations.bsb: Have I not written for you thirty sayings about counsel and knowledge,
translations.kjv: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
translations.asv: Have not I written unto thee excellent things Of counsels and knowledge,
